ComplexTypes.reason: Milo 1.1.7 decodes and encodes a Structure field of the abstract Enumeration DataType (TestData ScalarStructureDataType.EnumerationValue) as a Variant; the .NET stack encodes it as Int32 (Part 6 5.2.4: Enumerations are encoded as Int32). Milo then reads the following fields misaligned, silently drops the 19 trailing bytes, and its re-encoded write is rejected with Bad_DecodingError
ComplexTypes.issue: upstream issue to be filed at https://github.com/eclipse-milo/milo/issues (spec reference: OPC 10000-6 5.2.4, F.13)

LegacyServerInteropTests.ConnectWithWron.issue: upstream issue to be filed at https://github.com/eclipse-milo/milo/issues (OPC 10000-4 5.6.3 ActivateSession result codes)
